name: Board Office
description: The organisational department identified as the owner of the Board Risk Committee Charter.

name: Board of Directors
description: The primary governing body of FirstUK Bank and the designated owner of the Board Risk Committee Charter.

name: Board Risk Committee
description: A standing committee of the Board of Directors responsible for overseeing FirstUK Bank's enterprise risk management, capital adequacy, and internal controls.
context: The Board Risk Committee (BRC) is a standing committee of the Board of Directors responsible for overseeing FirstUK Bank's enterprise risk management, capital adequacy, and internal controls.

name: Board of Directors
description: The primary governing body of FirstUK Bank, of which the Board Risk Committee is a standing committee.
context: The Board Risk Committee (BRC) is a standing committee of the Board of Directors

name: Board
description: The primary governing body of FirstUK Bank responsible for appointing the Committee Secretary.

name: Independent Non-Executive Director (Chair)
description: The independent non-executive director serving as the Chair of the committee.

name: Independent Non-Executive Directors
description: Two to three independent non-executive directors serving as members of the committee.

name: Chief Risk Officer
description: Executive member of the committee who is non-voting in deliberations.
context: Chief Risk Officer (executive, non-voting in deliberations)

name: Chief Financial Officer
description: Executive member of the committee who is non-voting in deliberations.
context: Chief Financial Officer (executive, non-voting in deliberations)

name: Committee Secretary
description: An individual appointed by the Board to provide administrative support and maintain records and meeting minutes.

name: FCA/PRA Independence Definition
description: The regulatory definition provided by the FCA and PRA used to determine the independence of committee members.
context: Majority of members must be independent (per FCA/PRA definition)

name: Enterprise Risk Management Framework
description: The overarching framework for managing risk across the bank, subject to approval and strategic oversight.

name: Risk Appetite Statement
description: The formal statement defining the level of risk the bank is willing to accept to achieve its strategic objectives.
context: Review and approve Risk Appetite Statement

name: Pillar 1 Capital Ratio — Minimum >15%
description: The minimum required capital ratio under Pillar 1 regulations, set at greater than 15%.

name: Credit Risk
description: Risk associated with loan portfolio quality, borrower concentration, and major lending decisions, specifically for mortgages exceeding £500k.
context: Review credit strategy and risk limits

name: Operational Risk
description: Risk arising from internal processes, people, and systems, monitored via KRIs and control environment assessments.

name: Compliance and Regulatory Risk
description: Risk related to regulatory compliance, the management of regulatory relationships, and the remediation of audit findings.

name: Fraud and Financial Crime Risk
description: Risk encompassing fraud incidents, AML/KYC effectiveness, and the filing of Suspicious Activity Reports (SARs).

name: Cybersecurity and Technology Risk
description: Risk related to cybersecurity threats, system availability, technology investments, and incident response.

name: Mortgages
description: Banking product subject to major lending decision reviews when the value exceeds £500k.

name: AML/KYC Effectiveness
description: The ongoing monitoring and assessment of Anti-Money Laundering and Know Your Customer control effectiveness.

name: SAR Filings
description: The review and monitoring of Suspicious Activity Report filings as part of financial crime oversight.

name: Full Board of Directors
description: The primary governing body of FirstUK Bank to which the Committee Chair reports key decisions and issues, and which holds ultimate accountability to regulators.
context: Reports to: Full Board of Directors

name: Chief Risk Officer
description: The executive role responsible for providing risk management updates to the committee.
context: Receives from: Chief Risk Officer (risk management updates)

name: Chief Financial Officer
description: The executive role responsible for reporting on capital and financial risk.
context: Receives from: Chief Financial Officer (capital, financial risk)

name: Compliance Head
description: The executive role responsible for reporting on regulatory, AML, and KYC matters.

name: Head of Internal Audit
description: The executive role responsible for reporting audit findings to the committee.
context: Receives from: Head of Internal Audit (audit findings)

name: Chief Technology Officer
description: The executive role responsible for reporting on technology risk.
context: Receives from: Chief Technology Officer (technology risk)

name: Financial Conduct Authority
description: A regulatory body to which the Board is accountable and which may meet with the committee directly.
context: Regulators may meet with committee directly

name: Prudential Regulation Authority
description: A regulatory body to which the Board is accountable and which may meet with the committee directly.
context: Regulators may meet with committee directly

name: Chief Risk Officer
description: The office of the Chief Risk Officer, responsible for providing input into the agenda setting for committee meetings.
context: Chair sets agenda (input from CRO, CFO, Compliance)

name: Chief Financial Officer
description: The office of the Chief Financial Officer, responsible for providing input into the agenda setting for committee meetings.
context: Chair sets agenda (input from CRO, CFO, Compliance)

name: Compliance Department
description: The Compliance function, responsible for providing input into the agenda setting for committee meetings.
context: Chair sets agenda (input from CRO, CFO, Compliance)

name: Internal Audit
description: The internal audit function, which is invited to attend committee meetings at least quarterly.

name: Capital Ratios
description: Capital ratios are listed as a standing item for review during committee meetings.
context: Standing items: Risk appetite, capital ratios, incidents, KRIs

name: Key Risk Indicators (KRIs)
description: Key Risk Indicators are listed as a standing item for review during committee meetings.
context: Standing items: Risk appetite, capital ratios, incidents, KRIs

name: Risk Appetite
description: The bank's risk appetite is a standing item for discussion and review during committee meetings.
context: Standing items: Risk appetite, capital ratios, incidents, KRIs

name: Annual Review of Risk Appetite Statement
description: The formal requirement to review the Risk Appetite Statement annually to ensure alignment with strategic objectives and the definition of capital, loss, and regulatory tolerances.

name: Annual Capital Plan Review
description: The annual review of the bank's capital plan, including the assessment of stress testing scenarios such as recession, market shock, and fraud.
context: Stress testing scenarios (recession, market shock, fraud)

name: Quarterly Capital Ratio Monitoring
description: A quantitative monitoring process for the bank's capital ratio conducted on a quarterly basis.

name: Dividend and Distribution Approval
description: The governance process for approving dividends or other distributions if applicable.

name: Annual Internal Audit Plan Review and Approval
description: The annual review and approval of the Internal Audit plan, alongside the approval of the Internal Audit budget.

name: Audit Findings Remediation Monitoring
description: The ongoing task of monitoring audit findings and their subsequent remediation process.

name: Internal Audit Independence Assessment
description: The formal assessment of the independence of the Internal Audit function.

name: Regulatory Response Approval
description: The governance process for approving formal responses to the FCA and PRA following the receipt of feedback.

name: Regulatory Finding Remediation Planning
description: The process of planning remediation actions in response to regulatory concerns or orders.

name: Annual Risk Management Training
description: Mandatory annual risk management training provided to the Board.

name: Quarterly Market Risk Overview
description: A quarterly reporting and education requirement providing an overview of market risk to the Board.

name: Emerging Risk and Regulatory Change Briefings
description: The provision of briefings to the Board regarding emerging risks and updates on regulatory changes.

name: Committee Approval of Risk Appetite Statement
description: The Committee is granted the formal authority to approve the Risk Appetite Statement.

name: Committee Approval of Major Risk Policy Changes
description: The Committee is responsible for approving major changes to risk policies, specifically citing credit policy as an example.
context: Major risk policy changes (e.g., credit policy)

name: Committee Approval of Risk Limits and KRIs
description: The Committee holds the authority to approve risk limits and Key Risk Indicators (KRIs).

name: Committee Approval of Risk Remediation Strategies >£500k
description: Risk remediation strategies requiring a spend exceeding £500,000 must be approved by the Committee.

name: Committee Approval of Large Lending Decisions (Mortgages >£500k)
description: The Committee is the decision authority for large lending decisions, specifically mortgages exceeding £500,000.

name: Committee Approval of Stress Testing Scenarios
description: The Committee is responsible for decisions regarding stress testing scenarios.

name: Board Approval of Capital Raising and Deployment
description: Decisions regarding the raising or deployment of capital require formal Board approval.

name: Board Approval of Regulatory Capital Requirements Compliance
description: Compliance with regulatory capital requirements is a matter requiring Board-level approval.

name: Board Approval of Significant Strategic Risk Changes
description: Any significant changes to the bank's strategic risk profile must be approved by the Board.

name: Board Approval of Major Acquisitions
description: Major acquisitions, where applicable, require formal approval from the Board.

name: Board Approval of Large Financial Provisions and Write-offs
description: The Board is the decision authority for large financial provisions or write-offs.

name: Operational Risk Incident Threshold — Executive Authority <£10k
description: Executive authority is limited to operational risk incidents with a value of less than £10,000.

name: Fraud Reimbursement Threshold — Executive Authority <£5,000
description: Executive authority for fraud reimbursement is capped at £5,000.

name: Technology Investment Threshold — Executive Authority <£100k
description: Executive authority for technology investments is limited to amounts under £100,000.

name: Credit Risk
description: Credit risk is managed through specific credit policies and lending decision thresholds, including Board and Committee oversight for large exposures.
context: Major risk policy changes (e.g., credit policy)

name: Operational Risk
description: Operational risk is managed with a specific executive authority threshold for incidents under £10,000.

name: Fraud Risk
description: Fraud risk management includes defined executive authority for reimbursements up to £5,000.

name: AML/KYC Risk
description: Standard AML/KYC approvals fall under Executive Authority.

name: Technology Risk
description: Technology risk is managed through investment limits, with executive authority for spends under £100,000.

name: Annual Committee Effectiveness and Self-Assessment Review
description: A formal annual review process to evaluate the effectiveness of the committee, including member skills, experience, and overall meeting processes. The assessment focuses on composition, information quality, and engagement with management.

name: Reporting of Self-Assessment Results to the Board
description: A requirement to report the results of the committee's annual self-assessment and effectiveness review to the Board.

name: Provision of Identified Committee Training
description: The identification and delivery of specific training for committee members based on the gaps found during the skills and experience assessment.

name: Implementation of Committee Process Improvements
description: The execution of improvements to committee processes arising from the evaluation of meeting effectiveness and information quality.

name: Risk Committee
description: The governance body responsible for risk oversight, maintaining regulatory correspondence, and ensuring committee composition and meeting frequency meet regulatory standards.
context: Risk Committee Chair may meet with regulators directly

name: FCA/PRA Regulatory Standards for Committee Governance
description: Regulatory requirements governing the composition, meeting frequency, and level of risk oversight detail required for the bank's committee documentation.
context: Risk oversight sufficiently detailed per regulations

name: Risk Department
description: The organisational department responsible for risk management, referenced within the related policies and procedures section.

name: Board Approval of Committee Charter Review
description: The Full Board of Directors approved changes to the Committee Charter during the annual review process. The decision was finalized on 2026-01-15 and is effective upon approval.
context: Changes Approved By: Full Board of Directors

name: Full Board of Directors
description: The highest governing body of FirstUK Bank responsible for the approval of Committee Charter changes.
context: Changes Approved By: Full Board of Directors

name: Board Approval of Initial Charter
description: The Board formally approved the initial version (1.0) of the charter on 2026-01-15.

name: Board
description: The highest governing body of FirstUK Bank responsible for the approval of the charter.

name: Board Adoption of Document
description: The Board of Directors formally adopted the document on 2026-01-15.
context: Adopted by: Board of Directors — Date: 2026-01-15

name: Risk Committee Chair Sign-Off
description: The Risk Committee Chair provided formal sign-off/adoption of the document on 2026-01-15.

name: Board of Directors
description: The primary governing body of FirstUK Bank responsible for the adoption of the document.

name: Risk Committee
description: The committee responsible for risk oversight, represented by the Chair in the sign-off process.
